f.pu: The natural complex Lake Achchen was declared a Natural Monument in order to preserve the largest water bodies in Chukotka, which are the spawning grounds for valuable fish species.
f.re: On the territory of the Natural Monument, any activity that entails a violation of its safety is prohibited, including: 1. destruction of aquatic and coastal vegetation; 2. geological exploration and mining; 3. industrial, sports and amateur fishing.
f.rn: Decree of the Government of the Chukotka Autonomous Okrug dated April 22, 2022 No. 207
